reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. I told him I'm treating "Gate 34" as unverified, because nothing he can see backs it up.

- **What I checked:** the brain, plus the channel history and public files he has access to. Nothing mentions a "Marlowe rollout" at Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) or a Gate 34.
- **What the notes do say:** the QFL notes he can see only mention their Eau Claire yard: Dock Doors 14–18 and Gate 3.
- **Who can confirm:** QFL is a North team account (Dana Okafor's), so I told him to check with Dana or Ilse Varga, the North team lead. I also said I won't pass it on as fact until one of them confirms it.

I didn't look in #inc-qfl-sev1 or the North channels, because Hollis isn't a member of them.
